item.description: The base Builder class's _send method does not properly handle async generators. It only supports synchronous generators and iterators, causing TypeError when encountering async generators during yield operations.
item.contract: The _send method should detect when a generator is an async generator and handle it appropriately using __anext__() instead of send(). The method should support both synchronous and asynchronous generators.

item.description: The AsyncResultBuilder._send method has incomplete handling of async generators. It attempts to detect async generators but doesn't properly handle the async iteration protocol.
item.contract: The AsyncResultBuilder._send method should properly detect and handle async generators using __anext__() and correctly process awaitable values yielded from async generators.

item.description: The AsyncOptionBuilder._send method has the same async generator handling issues as AsyncResultBuilder, and also has a binding issue where it returns None instead of a proper Option.
item.contract: The AsyncOptionBuilder._send method should properly detect and handle async generators using __anext__() and ensure proper Option return values for all code paths.

item.description: The base Builder.__call__ method has a bug where it sets result = None initially and then compares it to None in the loop condition, which breaks when result gets a proper value.
item.contract: The loop logic in Builder.__call__ should correctly track result state without relying on None comparison for control flow.

item.description: The AsyncResultBuilder.__call__ method incorrectly awaits self.run(result) which is not an async method, causing runtime errors.
item.contract: The AsyncResultBuilder.__call__ method should not await self.run(result) as it's not an async method.
item.acceptance: All async result builder tests that have runtime errors
